about.heroTitle: A Miami renovation company that keeps things simple
about.heroSubtitle: Kitchens, bathrooms, flooring, painting, drywall and full home renovations, planned clearly and finished with care.
story: Malben Inc. is a renovation company based in Miami, FL. We work on kitchens, bathrooms, flooring, interior and exterior painting, drywall repairs and complete home renovations for homeowners across the Miami area.

Every project starts with a conversation and a visit. We listen to what you want to change, look at the space with you and put together a written estimate, so you know what the work includes before anything begins.
During the job we keep the site clean, keep you informed and finish the details properly. When the work is done, we walk through it with you to make sure everything is the way you expected.
about.valuesIntro: Four standards we hold ourselves to on every project, large or small.

values.title: Clear communication
values.desc: Straight answers about scope, timing and cost, from the first call to the last day.

values.title: Careful workmanship
values.desc: Proper preparation, suitable materials and finish work we are glad to put our name on.

values.title: Respect for your home
values.desc: Protected floors, contained dust and a tidy site at the end of each day.

values.title: Honest scope
values.desc: We recommend what the space actually needs, nothing more.
